## Summary

Describe the change and why it belongs in Pocket Grove.

## Area

- [ ] 3D assets / scene
- [ ] Build / placement interactions
- [ ] Task economy / shop
- [ ] HUD / accessibility
- [ ] Persistence / data model
- [ ] Documentation / tooling
- [ ] Release / CI

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Visual QA at 1440×900 and/or 1280×720
- [ ] Screenshots updated if visuals changed
- [ ] Docs/CHANGELOG updated if behavior or catalog changed

## Product invariants

- [ ] 8×8 grid and 1×1 footprints preserved
- [ ] Ten-item catalog prices preserved (or spec/docs/tests updated intentionally)
- [ ] Rewards still 10/25/50 and one-shot
- [ ] Starter state still 60 coins / 2 tiles / 3 tasks
- [ ] No external assets, network calls, or secrets added

## Screenshots / notes

Before/after images or a short explanation of visual changes.
